backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles and admin‑gated image upload using access control, with storage for images and profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UX changes, impacted frontend files, components, and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of all major frontend source files.
frontend/.gitignore: Ignore rules for dependencies, build outputs, logs, env files, IDE metadata, OS junk, and temp files.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind setup defining OKLCH color tokens, themes, and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Project overview describing architecture, tooling, and development setup for the frontend.
frontend/scripts/REDEPLOY.md: Runbook describing prerequisites and step‑by‑step instructions for redeploying the app.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.ps1: PowerShell script automating frontend rebuild, backend binding generation, and canister deployment with logs.
frontend/scripts/redeploy.sh: Bash script performing clean install, frontend build, backend binding generation, and deployment with logging.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling layout, category selection and hover effects, HDD hub interaction, and vinyl player placement.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty placeholder file for a modal component.
Truncated file with no visible content to summarize.
frontend/src/components/ElectronHoverLin: Canvas-based animation drawing a glowing line and moving particles between two DOM elements.
frontend/src/components/StudioComponents: Defines UI components like PortfolioShell and VinylPlayer with background fallbacks, audio playback, and asset-loading logic.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Exports a list of category definitions with ids, names, and descriptive text.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Provides placeholder overlay content for categories, including text sections and photo metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context for Internet Identity login, state management, and AuthClient initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoGallery.ts: React-query hooks for listing, uploading images with progress, and checking admin status via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, CSS variables for light/dark themes, utility classes, and custom animations.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Empty placeholder file for future asset fallback logic.
frontend/src/lib/assets.ts: Provides asset URL resolution, SVG placeholder generation, and fallback chains for images.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Empty placeholder file for future asset URL helpers.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a helper that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that initializes React, React Query, Internet Identity, and loads global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration with custom colors, theme extensions, plugins, and CSS variable integration.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite config enabling React, env loading, proxying, aliases, and base-path-safe builds.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, feature requests, and UI/animation update requirements for redeployment.
